Greeks units

ThingThis repoUsual vendor / desk trap
Vega per 1.00 vol per 1% → multiply vendor vega × 100 to compare
Theta per year of calendar time per calendar day → × 365; trading-day would be / 252 (available on GreeksConventions, not the default)
Delta / gamma spot (∂/∂S); dual always also filled forward / dual-only reports

Pricing inputs

ThingThis repoUsual vendor / desk trap
F put-call parity on the chain at min |C−P|: F = K + erT(C − P) when the Treasury curve is present (method=parity); undiscounted F = K + C − P otherwise (parity-r0). For VIX this is the VX future of that expiry, not a spot VIX. I:SPX print (not entitled)
T ACT/365 to settlement instant on the live path (SPY/SPXW 16:00 ET PM; SPX monthlies and VIX/VIXW 09:30 ET AM). On the day-bar path the day count is a passed object (pricing.daycount); the default is the hybrid — sessions over 252 where the calendar can vouch, ACT/365 past the horizon — and every landed atm_term_structure / vol_surface row stamps which convention produced its t_years (bus/252 or act/365, never the name hybrid). Two quantities are kept apart there: vol time, the T in σ√T, is what the convention decides; money time, the T in e−rT and the Treasury-curve tenor, is always ACT/365 because interest accrues on weekends. expiry date at UTC midnight understates T (~108 bp IV at 7 DTE); converting the discount factor and the curve tenor along with σ√T
r Treasury curve via rate_for (scalar --r / DRIFT_CHECK_R override) one flat scalar rate for every maturity

Market data

ThingThis repoUsual vendor / desk trap
Market price last trade else day close. A last print older than --max-trade-age-min (default 60) is skipped, not fallen back to close. NBBO mid (not entitled)
